methods.name: Finite spectral decimation / parity-curvature completion calculus
capabilities: exact rational normalized Dirichlet determinant coefficients
exact target-free Wallis partial products and decreasing upper companions
finite fourth-order completion interval endpoint construction with exact width 2/(15 q^4)
exact rational sign certificate used by the analytic theorem to prove tau<4

reuse_resolution.how_applied_or_why_not: T5 supplies the finite coarse/fine refinement typing and T7 supplies finite involution/parity typing. Neither current interface provides algebraic matrix-spectrum decimation, parity-curvature readout, or target-free spectral completion intervals. The extracted method therefore extends T5 narrowly rather than creating a new top-level family.

methods.hard_boundary: Finite exact spectral carriers and endpoint construction do not prove primitive G0 Cell-rotation semantics. Matrix eigenmode spectrum is not T8 relation-observable spectrum and a Laplacian-shaped matrix is not automatically a T10 toppling system. Analytic completion, first-zero existence, Euler product, and classical pi identification remain separate theorem layers. Full hypercube multiplicities may not be silently erased to the Hamming-shell quotient.
methods.cross_family_note: Current #1158 independently constructs the same dyadic radical state from a G1 finite rotation-refinement carrier and proves Pi_rot=tau=2 W_infinity. This #1159 subtool contributes the Dirichlet spectral origin, parity-curvature collapse, and fourth-order two-scale certificate; it does not identify the finite carriers.
